incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty trigger PD-88211 fired for service=inference-gateway-usw2 (5xx error-rate jump). Alert rule: gateway_5xx_rate > 0.05 for 2m. Logs: sample http 502s from auth-proxy sidecar. Stack: edge -> auth-proxy -> inference-gateway -> model-pool
Sophie L.: Acked PD-88211 (on-call) :white_check_mark: I'm on it. First pass: check recent deploys and autoscale metrics.
Raj K.: seeing the same in Grafana (usw2). 1m error rate ~6.8% across hostpool, spikes concentrated on hostgroup-a. Query I ran: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",status=~\"5..\"}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\"}[1m]))`
Marta G.: @Sophie any chance this is the canary we flipped 4m ago? deploy-bot shows partial rollout of `gateway@2026-03-15T02:12` to 20% traffic.
Sophie L.: good call. @deploy-bot what does rollout state look like?
deploy-bot: rollout `gateway@2026-03-15T02:12` -> 20% canary, 80% stable. No automatic rollback configured.
Raj K.: logs show repeated upstream 502s from auth-proxy: `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway - upstream reset`. sample stack trace from gateway container:
```
2026-03-15T02:25:11Z ERROR handler.go:142 upstream reset: read tcp 10.4.2.7:443: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T02:25:11Z WARN kvcache.go:77 cache miss, fallback to upstream
```
Sophie L.: quick mitigation options: 1) Pause canary or route 100% to stable. 2) Scale auth-proxy replicas. 3) Roll back canary. Which do we want first?
Marta G.: Pause canary and scale auth-proxy x2. Pausing is fast and non-disruptive.
Theo M.: I'll flip routing. Running (kubectl patch svc) command now.
Theo M.: `kubectl -n prod patch deployment gateway --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"metadata": {"annotations": {"rollout-paused": "true"}}}}}'` // pauses our custom controller rollout routing
Sophie L.: routing flip acknowledged, traffic moved back to stable (confirmed in deploy dashboard). Watching error rates...
Raj K.: scaling auth-proxy: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment auth-proxy --replicas=6` -> going from 3 to 6. CPU for auth-proxy was at 92% on the problematic hosts.
incident-bot: Noted runbook step executed: paused rollout, scaled auth-proxy. Tagged PD-88211 with runbook-steps.
Marta G.: after pause+scale, 5xx rate fell to 1.2% in 30s, then to 0.3% in 2 mins. Partial customer impact: 12 customers reported 502s via support queue (initial).
Sophie L.: good trend. I'll keep PD-88211 acked and mark as investigating. We need a post-incident note: correlate to canary commit `c3f9d8b` which touched connection pooling in auth-proxy client.
Raj K.: grabbing auth-proxy logs from hostgroup-a for the suspect commit and diffing config.
Marta G.: FYI PagerDuty sent an auto-escalation to platform-leads at +5m because another alert from the same rule refired before mitigation finished. That caused duplicate notifications. Suggest we temporarily suppress noisy alert rule for `gateway_5xx_rate` while we stabilize.
Sophie L.: Agreed. I'm suppressing the alert for 10m now.
Sophie L.: `curl -X POST https://alertmanager/api/v1/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"gateway_5xx_rate"}],"startsAt":"2026-03-15T02:26:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-15T02:36:00Z","createdBy":"sophie","comment":"suppress during mitigation"}'` -> silence created :lock:
Raj K.: note we should action rollback of `c3f9d8b` in a canary-controlled manner if auth-proxy team confirms the change. For now keep stable, collect more logs and run a targeted test run.
Marta G.: support pinged customers with a templated message. No billing impact expected; just transient errors.
Theo M.: I restarted one auth-proxy sidecar on hostgroup-a (`kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy --field-selector=spec.nodeName=host-a-12`), that node had repeated conn resets.
Sophie L.: good. Let's keep monitoring for 30m. If error rate stays <0.5% and customer reports stop, we can close PD-88211 as mitigated and open a follow-up for root cause and rollout policy changes.
incident-bot: PD-88211 status: acknowledged -> mitigation in-progress. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/gateway-5xx.
Raj K.: logging action item: increase sampling for `auth-proxy` traces for the next 1h. Also add a metric to track upstream TCP resets.
Marta G.: postmortem owners: Marta + Raj. Sophie to coordinate customer comms. I'll create the incident doc after we confirm final scope.
Sophie L.: closing notes for thread: temporary silence removed at 02:36Z, keep an eye for regression. Thanks all :heart:
pagerduty-bot: PD-88211 -> status changed to resolved by Sophie L. (auto-resolve triggered after alert silence lifted and no further triggers).
file_notes: autogenerated slack thread present as a single string, messages prefixed with names. Contains bot messages, code snippets, and mitigation steps.
